千:qian1.note: 千 (qiān, "thousand") had no card at all: CC-CEDICT has two entries sharing the key 千/qian1 — 千 ("thousand") and 韆 ("used in 鞦韆|秋千[qiu1 qian1]", a bound form with no independent meaning). Adjudication: 千 is obviously intended. Content copied verbatim from the 千/千/qian1 CC-CEDICT entry.

它:ta1.note: 它 (tā, "it") had no card at all: CC-CEDICT has two entries sharing the key 它/ta1 — 它 ("it") and 牠 ("it, pronoun for an animal" — a Traditional/Taiwan-only orthographic distinction; mainland Simplified writing uses 它 for both inanimate objects and animals). Adjudication: 它 is the correct, standard mainland form. Content copied verbatim from the 它/它/ta1 CC-CEDICT entry.

玩:wan2.note: 玩 (wán, "to play") had no card at all: CC-CEDICT has two entries sharing the key 玩/wan2 — 玩 ("to play/to have fun/...") and 翫 ("variant of 玩[wan2]/Taiwan pr. [wan4]", a pure orthographic variant). Adjudication: 玩 is obviously intended. Content copied verbatim from the 玩/玩/wan2 CC-CEDICT entry; the "(Taiwan pr. [wan4])" bracket is left in raw numbered form deliberately, per LR-002's precedent for 和:he2 — pipeline/sense-annotations.ts converts pronunciation-variant brackets to diacritic form automatically post-override.

药:yao4.note: 药 (yào, "medicine") had no card at all: CC-CEDICT has two entries sharing the key 药/yao4 — 葯 ("leaf of the iris/variant of 藥|药[yao4]", a narrow archaic/variant sense) and 藥 ("medicine/drug/...", the real, substantive word, with classifiers 種|种,服,味). Adjudication: 藥's content is obviously intended. Content and classifiers (种/服/味, trad→simp mapped) copied verbatim from the 藥/药/yao4 CC-CEDICT entry.

senses: (emphatic, esp. in contrast or correction) really; actually
才:cai2.note: 才 (cái) had no card at all: CC-CEDICT has two entries sharing the key 才/cai2 — 才 (the real character, carrying both the noun "talent" sense and the essential HSK-3 adverbial senses "just now/only then/not until") and 纔 ("(variant of 才[cai2]) just now/(before a quantity) only" — purely a classical/Taiwan variant character for a subset of 才's own adverbial senses, not a distinct word). Adjudication: 才's own, complete content is obviously intended. Content copied verbatim from the 才/才/cai2 CC-CEDICT entry.

刚才:gang1cai2.note: 刚才 (gāngcái, "just now") had no card at all: CC-CEDICT has two entries sharing the key 刚才/gang1cai2 — 剛才 ("just now/a moment ago") and 剛纔 ("just now (variant of 剛才|刚才[gang1 cai2])" — a pure variant-character spelling of the same word, using 纔 in place of 才). Adjudication: 剛才's content is obviously intended; 剛纔 is not a distinct word. Content copied verbatim from the 剛才/刚才/gang1cai2 CC-CEDICT entry.

刮:gua1.note: 刮 (guā) had no card at all: CC-CEDICT has two entries sharing the key 刮/gua1 — 刮 itself ("to scrape/to blow/to shave/to plunder/to extort" — already the unchanged Simplified form and already includes the weather sense) and 颳 ("to blow (of the wind)" only, a Traditional character that also simplifies to 刮 and duplicates a subset of 刮's own senses). Adjudication: 刮's own, complete entry is the correct and sufficient source — it already contains everything 颳 supplies. Content is 刮's own CC-CEDICT senses, reordered to put "to blow (of the wind)" first since 刮风 (guāfēng) is the HSK-3 collocation this word is taught for — check 3, ordered sensibly for a learner; no sense added, removed, or altered in wording from the CC-CEDICT original.

伞:san3.note: 伞 (sǎn, "umbrella") had no card at all: CC-CEDICT has two entries sharing the key 伞/san3 — 傘 ("umbrella/parasol/CL:把") and 繖 ("damask silk/variant of 傘|伞[san3]", an archaic, unrelated-primary-sense character). Adjudication: 傘's content is obviously intended. Content and classifier (把) copied verbatim from the 傘/伞/san3 CC-CEDICT entry.

腿:tui3.note: 腿 (tuǐ, "leg") had no card at all: CC-CEDICT has two entries sharing the key 腿/tui3 — 腿 itself ("leg/CL:條|条") and 骽 ("hip bone/old variant of 腿[tui3]", an archaic variant). Adjudication: 腿's own content is obviously intended. Content and classifier (条) copied verbatim from the 腿/腿/tui3 CC-CEDICT entry.

冬:dong1.note: 冬 (dōng, "winter") is a masked gap, not merely a waived one: the ONLY card that shipped under this headword at HSK-3 was 冬:Dong1 ("surname Dong", excluded in this review — see LR-004 exclusions), because the real word's own (headword, reading) key — 冬/dong1 — conflicts between the entry 冬 ("winter") and a second entry 鼕/冬[dong1] ("(onom.) beating a drum; rat-a-tat", an unrelated archaic onomatopoeia bundled under the same traditional character used for the surname). Adjudication: 冬's own "winter" content is obviously intended. Content copied verbatim from the 冬/冬/dong1 CC-CEDICT entry.

花:hua1.note: 花 (huā, "flower") is a masked gap: the ONLY card that shipped under this headword at HSK-3 was 花:Hua1 ("surname Hua", excluded in this review), because the real word's key — 花/hua1 — conflicts among three entries: 花 itself (substantive), 芲 ("old variant of 花", non-substantive), and 蘤 ("variant of 花.../also pr. wei3", largely a duplicate variant pointer). Adjudication: 花's own content is obviously intended. Content and all six classifiers copied verbatim from the 花/花/hua1 CC-CEDICT entry, with one sense dropped: CC-CEDICT's trailing "(coll.) lecherous; lustful" — a real but crude/adult-register sense of 花心-type usage, inappropriate and out of context on a beginner "flower/to spend money" card (same category of correction as this review's other vulgar/coarse-content trims — see LR-004 Corrections).

秋:qiu1.note: 秋 (qiū, "autumn") is a masked gap: the ONLY card that shipped under this headword at HSK-3 was 秋:Qiu1 ("surname Qiu", excluded in this review), because the real word's key — 秋/qiu1 — conflicts between 秋 itself (substantive) and 鞦 ("used in 鞦韆|秋千[qiu1 qian1]", a bound form). A third entry, 秌 ("old variant of 秋"), is non-substantive. Adjudication: 秋's own content is obviously intended. Content copied verbatim from the 秋/秋/qiu1 CC-CEDICT entry.

云:yun2.note: 云 (yún, "cloud") is a masked gap: the ONLY card that shipped under this headword at HSK-3 was 云:Yun2 ("surname Yun; short name for Yunnan", excluded in this review), because the real word's key — 云/yun2 — conflicts between 云 itself ("(classical) to say", a literary usage as in 人云亦云) and 雲 ("cloud/CL:朵", the substantive everyday word). Adjudication: 雲's content ("cloud") is obviously the HSK-3-intended word; 云's own "(classical) to say" sense is literary register, not beginner/intermediate vocabulary. Content and classifier (朵) copied verbatim from the 雲/云/yun2 CC-CEDICT entry.

senses: classifier for birds and certain animals, one of a pair, some utensils, vessels etc
只:zhi1.note: 只 (zhī), the classifier, is a masked gap distinct from 只:zhi3 ("only; merely; just", already correctly shipped and approved in this review): the HSK-3 source list's own forms for 只 include both zhi3 and zhi1, but the zhi1 (classifier) reading's key — 只/zhi1 — conflicts between 秖 ("grain that has begun to ripen", archaic/obscure) and 隻 ("classifier for birds and certain animals, one of a pair, some utensils, vessels etc", the real, extremely common classifier used throughout the language — 一只猫, 一只手, 一只鞋). A third entry, 只/只[zhi1] ("variant of 隻|只[zhi1]"), is a non-substantive self-referential pointer. Adjudication: 隻's content is obviously the intended classifier. This card does not exist at any other reviewed HSK level (checked HSK 1–4) — verified via LR-004's cross-deck check. Content copied verbatim from the 隻/只/zhi1 CC-CEDICT entry.

senses: towards; to face; to turn towards
